# Kindlepreneur

> Kindlepreneur is Dave Chesson's platform for teaching authors how to self-publish and market books on Amazon Kindle.

Kindlepreneur provides comprehensive education and resources for aspiring and established authors looking to succeed in self-publishing. The platform combines writing craft instruction, book publishing guidance, and marketing strategies specifically tailored for the Amazon Kindle ecosystem.

## Author Education & Courses

- [Authorpreneur Academy - Kindlepreneur](https://academy.kindlepreneur.com): Dave Chesson's comprehensive self-publishing course for Kindle authors covering book publishing, marketing strategies, and writing craft
